title: An Evolutionary Agentic Approach for Open-ended Image Quality Perception
abstract: arXiv:2609.22942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models are rapidly expanding image quality assessment (IQA) beyond traditional fidelity factors to emerging dimensions such as physical plausibility and text-rendering correctness. However, existing IQA models rely on fixed definitions and heavy supervision, making them difficult to extend to open-ended perceptual dimensions. We identify holistic bias as an important limitation: when scoring an unseen dimension, models reuse generic quality priors, leading to scoring errors and rank inversion. To address this, we propose PACE (Perceptual Agentic Collaborative Evolution), a training-free multi-agent framework that formulates open-ended IQA as explicit protocol construction. Given a target dimension, PACE uses collaborative agents to construct an evaluation protocol composed of verifiable Visual Question Answering (VQA) probes, grounding evaluation in concrete visual evidence rather than holistic impressions. translated_title: 一种用于开放式图像质量感知的进化式智能体方法
translated_abstract: 生成式模型正在迅速将图像质量评估（IQA）从传统的保真度因素扩展到物理合理性和文本渲染正确性等新兴维度。然而，现有的IQA模型依赖于固定的定义和大量的监督，使其难以扩展到开放式的感知维度。我们识别出整体偏差是一个重要的局限性：在为未见过的维度打分时，模型会复用通用的质量先验，导致评分错误和排序反转。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PACE（感知智能体协同进化），这是一个无需训练的多智能体框架，将开放式IQA表述为显式的协议构建。给定一个目标维度，PACE利用协作智能体构建由可验证的视觉问答（VQA）探针组成的评估协议，将评估建立在具体的视觉证据而非整体印象之上。由此产生的协议……
tldr: 提出了PACE，一个无需训练的多智能体框架，通过协作智能体构建由可验证VQA探针组成的评估协议，将开放式图像质量评估建立在具体视觉证据之上，从而解决现有模型的整体偏差问题。
en_tdlr: PACE, a training-free multi-agent framework, addresses holistic bias in open-ended image quality assessment by using collaborative agents to construct evaluation protocols composed of verifiable VQA probes grounded in concrete visual evidence.
